summary_1line: During the Ashvamedha horse’s journey, Arjuna defeats the Gandhara forces, spares Sakuni’s son, and invites him to Yudhishthira’s sacrifice.

image_candidates.scene_text: Arjuna stands in his chariot drawing the Gandiva as a storm of arrows cuts through the Gandhara army of elephants, horses, and banners.
With a crescent-shaped arrow, Arjuna slices off the jeweled headgear of Sakuni’s son, sending it flying through the air like Jayadratha’s severed head.
The frightened Gandhara prince retreats as his mother and aged ministers approach Arjuna carrying an arghya in surrender.
